sessionStart.powershell: $s = (Get-Command sh -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if (-not $s) { $r = @(); $g = (Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if ($g) { $r += Split-Path (Split-Path $g) }; $r += "$env:ProgramFiles\Git", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Git"; $s = $r | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'bin\sh.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($s) { & $s "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/ss33" __prefetch-runtime }

userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $s = (Get-Command sh -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if (-not $s) { $r = @(); $g = (Get-Command git -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).Source; if ($g) { $r += Split-Path (Split-Path $g) }; $r += "$env:ProgramFiles\Git", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Git"; $s = $r | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $_ 'bin\sh.exe' } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | Select-Object -First 1 }; if ($s) { $input | & $s "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/ss33" hook copilot user-prompt-submitted }
